Prisoner Zero is an Australian animated children 's sci-fi , action-adventure series produced by Planet 55 Studios .

Ffizz is a British TV series created by ITV which ran from 1987 through 1989 which followed Jack Mowbray -LRB- Richard Griffiths -RRB- and Hugo Walker -LRB- Benjamin Whitrow -RRB- , who owned a wine business but never had to actually run it until their accountant died leaving them not only with the work but the surprising knowledge that they were out of money .
Prisoner is an Australian soap opera set in the Wentworth Detention Centre , a fictional women 's prison .
In the United States and United Kingdom it was known as Prisoner : Cell Block H , with the same title and Caged Women in Canada .
